changeSet.sql: UPDATE abac_policy_items api INNER JOIN user_sets us ON api.user_set_id = us.id SET api.user_set_key = us.user_set_key WHERE api.is_deleted = false AND us.is_deleted = false;
UPDATE abac_policy_items api INNER JOIN abac_policies ap ON api.policy_id = ap.policy_id SET api.policy_key = ap.policy_key WHERE api.is_deleted = false AND ap.is_deleted = false;

UPDATE abac_policy_items api INNER JOIN abac_policies ap ON api.policy_id = ap.policy_id INNER JOIN projects p ON ap.project_id = p.project_id SET api.project_key = p.project_key WHERE api.is_deleted = false AND ap.is_deleted = false AND p.is_deleted = false;
UPDATE abac_policy_items api INNER JOIN resource_set_actions rsa ON api.resource_set_action_id = rsa.id SET api.action_name = rsa.action_name WHERE api.is_deleted = false AND rsa.is_deleted = false;

UPDATE abac_policy_items api INNER JOIN resource_set_actions rsa ON api.resource_set_action_id = rsa.id INNER JOIN resource_sets rs ON rsa.resource_set_id = rs.id SET api.resource_set_key = rs.resource_set_key WHERE api.is_deleted = false AND rsa.is_deleted = false AND rs.is_deleted = false;
UPDATE abac_policy_items api LEFT JOIN scopes s ON api.scope_id = s.scope_id SET api.scope_key = s.scope_key WHERE api.is_deleted = false AND s.is_deleted = false;

changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_abac_policy_items_search ON abac_policy_items( project_key, scope_key, resource_set_key, action_name, user_set_key );
